data.summary:
Dynamic strategic and technical leader with extensive expertise in software development, solution architecture, and technical leadership. Proficient in designing and implementing innovative, scalable solutions leveraging skills in Java, Microservices, Cloud technologies and AI to drive impactful results across diverse industries.
A highly skilled and results-oriented technical professional with 18 years of experience in software development, specializing in Java/JakartaEE, Microservices, and Cloud technologies. Consistently delivering innovative, scalable solutions that drive business growth and operational excellence across diverse industries.
Architecture and implementation of multi-agent GenAI platform for IT operations integrating LLM
model with enterprise tools.
As a Solution Architect at HCL Technologies, strategically lead design and development processes, ensuring alignment with business goals, and managing cross-functional teams to deliver complex projects within time and budget constraints.
Demonstrated strong system design skills with extensive knowledge in microservices architecture. Successfully implemented & optimized microservices-based solutions over the last 5 years across diverse domains, including airline, fintech, insurance, & SIEM, resulting in enhanced scalability, performance, and modularity of critical systems.
Proficient in cloud-native application development with expertise in GCP and AWS, delivering highly scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient solutions. Known for driving operational efficiency and cost optimization, achieving a notable reduction in deployment time through the adoption of industry best practices and continuous improvement efforts.
An influential leader with strong mentoring skills, fostering a collaborative work environment that maximizes team performance. Passionate about staying ahead of industry trends, integrating emerging solutions such as container orchestration and serverless architecture to scale operations and optimize performance.
Demonstrates advanced expertise in software architecture, specializing in delivering robust solutions that meet business objectives and overcome technical challenges. Notable achievements include measurable improvements in operational outcomes, user engagement, and business impact through transformative technological initiatives.
Known for cultivating a high-performance culture by mentoring junior developers, promoting
continuous learning, and empowering teams to excel. This approach has contributed directly to the success of multiple projects and organizational growth.
